deliveryPolicy:
CURRENT FULFILMENT STATUS
The current checkout is configured for testing only: no goods are being shipped under the displayed test delivery option. A test-labelled option is not a promise of free delivery or a delivery date. If you have paid through this option, contact customer care with your VN order reference for help with your payment and the appropriate refund or fulfilment resolution.

DESTINATIONS, CHARGES AND TIMING
When fulfilment is available, select your actual destination at checkout. Only enabled destinations can be ordered for delivery. The delivery charge and available estimate are shown before payment; dispatch time is separate from transit time. The store's current dispatch note and destination rates are displayed on this page. Do not use another state to bypass an unavailable destination. Contact care if your destination or estimate is unclear. International delivery is offered only when explicitly enabled and priced at checkout. Any applicable import-charge information will be displayed before ordering.

PROCESSING AND PREORDERS
Orders can be placed at any time while checkout is open. Processing begins on the next business day, excluding weekends and public holidays. Payment must be verified before fulfilment. Any preorder or made-to-order timing must be disclosed on the product page before purchase; contact care if a promised dispatch window is missed.

ADDRESS CHANGES AND TRACKING
Check your name, telephone number, address, state and destination before payment. Contact care promptly for corrections; changes after dispatch depend on the carrier and may require an agreed additional charge. Keep your VN order reference. Use Track order in the Help centre with the purchase email to view the latest status. Carrier tracking is displayed when supplied; the VN order reference is not itself a courier tracking number.

DELAYS, MISSING OR DAMAGED PARCELS
Delivery estimates are estimates unless expressly guaranteed. If an order is late, marked delivered but missing, damaged or incomplete, contact care with the reference and details. We will investigate with the carrier and explain the next steps, including an appropriate replacement or refund where required. Photos can help but are not a condition of statutory rights. We do not treat a carrier scan alone as proof that every dispute is resolved.

FAILED DELIVERY AND CANCELLATION
If a carrier cannot deliver, contact care to arrange the next step. Any additional delivery charge must be explained and agreed before it is taken. Contact care promptly if you wish to cancel before dispatch. Once dispatched, the applicable return process applies. These terms do not remove rights that cannot be excluded by law.
returnPolicy:
CURRENT TEST ORDERS
The currently configured delivery option is test checkout only, with no shipment. If you have paid for a test-labelled order, contact customer care with your VN reference so we can review the payment and arrange the appropriate resolution. The garment return process below applies to goods actually supplied.

HOW TO REQUEST HELP
Email the customer-care address shown on this page or use Help centre → Track order with your VN reference and purchase email, then select the items concerned. Explain whether you need a return, exchange, cancellation or refund and why. Contact us promptly. We will confirm the next steps and correct return address; do not send goods to an address on a parcel without instructions.

FIT, SIZE AND CHANGE-OF-MIND REQUESTS
Contact care before sending a voluntary return or size exchange. We will confirm eligibility and any applicable window, costs and instructions in writing, based on the terms disclosed when you purchased. No fixed additional change-of-mind return window has yet been published. This does not limit your statutory rights. For an agreed change-of-mind return, keep pieces unworn, unwashed, unaltered and undamaged, with tags and included accessories. Trying on indoors to check fit is fine; avoid makeup, perfume and deodorant marks. Use protective packaging.

SETS, UNDERWEAR AND PERSONALISED ITEMS
Return complete sets or multipacks for an agreed change-of-mind return. For a fault affecting one component, contact care so we can arrange an appropriate remedy. Hygiene or personalised-item exclusions apply to voluntary returns only where clearly disclosed before purchase; they do not exclude remedies for faulty, incorrect or misdescribed goods. Do not remove an existing hygiene seal while deciding whether to keep an item. Sale pricing does not remove statutory rights.

FAULTY, INCORRECT OR MISDESCRIBED GOODS
Tell us about the issue as soon as reasonably possible. Provide your reference and a description; photos are useful when practical. We will assess the issue and arrange an appropriate repair, replacement or refund under applicable consumer law. We will cover reasonable necessary return costs for confirmed faults or our supply errors. Original-condition and change-of-mind conditions do not restrict these rights.

EXCHANGES AND RETURN COSTS
Exchanges depend on stock availability. We will confirm the replacement, any price difference and any return or redelivery charge before you agree. Do not make an extra payment without confirmed instructions. If an exchange is unavailable, we will explain the refund or other options you are entitled to; store credit will not replace a legally required refund without your agreement. Keep proof of posting or collection.

REFUNDS
We will confirm receipt and the result of any necessary inspection, explain an approval or rejection, and tell you the amount and expected processing time. Refunds go to the original payment method where possible; any alternative will be agreed securely with you. Payment-provider or bank processing can take additional time. A cancelled order or approved return does not itself mean funds have reached your account; ask care for the refund reference if needed. Any refund deadline required by law remains applicable.

CANCELLATIONS AND UNFULFILLED ORDERS
Contact care promptly to request cancellation. We will explain the position based on payment, dispatch and any special terms disclosed before purchase. If we cannot supply the goods as agreed, we will explain the available remedy, including a refund where required. Keep your confirmation and payment reference. Never send your card PIN, password or one-time code to request a refund.

YOUR RIGHTS AND POLICY CHANGES
This policy supplements applicable Nigerian consumer rights and does not waive rights concerning unsafe or defective goods, misleading descriptions, non-delivery or other protections that cannot be excluded. Later policy edits will not retrospectively reduce rights or commitments attached to an existing order. Contact customer care if you disagree with a decision; unresolved consumer complaints may be referred to the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission.
